annotations.title: List what a record is linked to

description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use to see which records of another type, or which notes, tasks, calls, meetings, conversations, line items or payments, one record is linked to inside an AI agent's system, such as the deals of a contact, the notes of a deal or the payments of an invoice. Not for the same record in the other connected systems (use find_linked_records). Where the answer holds only ids, read them with read_activities, and a conversation with read_conversation.

cursor.description: The cursor of the previous answer, to read the next page.

id.description: The id of that record in the system.

limit.description: How many to return per page, 1 to 100.

related.description: What to list: a record type, or an activity, a conversation, a side conversation, a line item or a payment.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agent_options, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.

type.description: The type of the record whose links to list.

name: list_related_records
title: List what a record is linked to
